about: Instruction patches applied to ffxivgame.exe 2012.09.19.0001 before translation (recomp --patches). Addresses and our own replacement instructions only. The same changes Garlemald Client (and the original Seventh Umbral launcher) make to the exe in memory or on disk.

patches.why: mov eax, 0x50E0E812 in place of the call that reads the host's Unix time for the lobby's encryption time: pinned to 2012-12-31 01:19:14 UTC, as the servers' SERVER_UTC expects (a present-day clock is rejected as far in its future, and the lobby stops after the account list)
a byte getter called with this = NULL from one of its callers (after the boat cinematic): test ecx first and return 0 through the out pointer
mov byte ptr [esi+0x20], 0 with the same uninitialized member as the getter above: the store is dropped
